english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the enjoyment or pleasure you get from something.

exampleSentences.english: This game is a lot of fun.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for enjoyment or something enjoyable.

exampleSentences.english: The greatest pleasure of travelling is meeting new friends.
exampleSentences.traditional: 旅行最大樂趣係識到新朋友。
exampleSentences.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 zeoi3 daai6 lok6 ceoi3 hai6 sik1 dou2 san1 pang4 jau5

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for something that brings enjoyment or happiness, such as the joys of parenthood.

exampleSentences.english: The joy of raising kids is watching them grow day by day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 湊仔嘅樂趣，就係見住佢一日一日咁大。
exampleSentences.jyutping: cau3 zai2 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 zau6 hai6 gin3 zyu6 keoi5 jat1 jat6 jat1 jat6 gam3 daai6

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for pleasure or an enjoyable thing, including an activity that gives someone pleasure.

exampleSentences.english: Watching the children learn new things is a real delight.
exampleSentences.traditional: 睇住啲小朋友學識新嘢，真係好有樂趣。
exampleSentences.jyutping: tai2 zyu6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 sik1 san1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the fun or pleasure something gives.

exampleSentences.english: The greatest enjoyment of this game is playing it with friends.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個遊戲最大嘅樂趣係同朋友一齊玩。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 hai6 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 waan2

english.note: Use this for the pleasure or amusement someone gets from something rather than for a physical kick.

exampleSentences.english: The biggest kick I get from gaming is playing with friends.

english.note: Use this for fun or enjoyment in general rather than for a particular funny incident.

exampleSentences.english: This activity is a lot of fun; we have a good giggle.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個活動好有樂趣，我哋玩得好開心。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 wut6 dung6 hou2 jau5 lok6 ceoi3 ngo5 dei6 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1

english.note: Use this when the source of satisfaction is an activity or experience that is enjoyable.

exampleSentences.english: The satisfaction of building models yourself is seeing them slowly take shape.
exampleSentences.traditional: 自己整模型嘅樂趣，就係慢慢砌出嚟。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zi6 gei2 zing2 mou4 jing4 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 zau6 hai6 maan6 maan6 cai3 ceot1 lei4
